entities.name: Tímea Babos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tímea Babos is a Hungarian professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. She is a former world No. 1 in this category by the WTA. She has won 28 WTA Tour doubles titles and three in singles. Babos is a four-time Grand Slam champion in women's doubles, having won the 2018 and 2020 Australian Opens, as well as the French Open in 2019 and 2020, all alongside Kristina Mladenovic.

She has won 28 WTA Tour doubles titles and three in singles. Babos is a four-time Grand Slam champion in women's doubles, having won the 2018 and 2020 Australian Opens, as well as the French Open in 2019 and 2020, all alongside Kristina Mladenovic.
